- Overestimate early in the forecast horizon, especially after sharp price spikes; reduce initial forecast values by 1–2%.
- Underestimate during periods of sustained downward trend; adjust downward bias by +0.5–1.5% to align with mean reversion.
- Overshoot after price spikes (e.g., 75+), leading to overcorrection; cap forecast at 5–10% below peak if spike >70.
- Lagged response to true price movements: model reacts 1–2 days too slowly; adjust forecast to match 3rd or 4th day’s true trend.
- Mean reversion bias: model holds too high a mean; reduce forecast mean by 1–3% if 30-day average >75.
- Avoid overfitting to recent high volatility; smooth forecast by 1–2% if 3 consecutive days show >1.5% volatility.
